brand-activation: At a gala, a guest tries your product. A week later, they remember the conversation. Where should that first meeting happen? There are three ways we can help.
First, activate at an existing event. We agree on the audience and the action, coordinate with the organizer, train the hosts, and follow up on results.
Second, partner with an experience we produce or are authorized to support. Sampling, sponsorships and live demos depend on the event, the agreed benefits and available space.
Third, create your own brand event. From a customer showcase to a product launch, we direct the program, catering, décor, multimedia, staffing and logistics.
Our team produces more than two hundred and fifty small and midsize events each year, in addition to corporate productions. We coordinate the experience from the first brief through the last guest.
Tell us who you want to reach and what you want them to do. Create your brand experience with VNV Events.
original-experiences: Sometimes the right event starts with how you want people to feel. A quiet brunch and a dance floor after dark call for very different rooms.
At Mommy and Daddy Break Club, a morning might move from gentle movement to coffee, brunch, and a conversation that actually has time to finish.
Retro Glam Sessions builds each edition around one decade. The stage lighting, the DJ set and the photo moments all speak the same visual language.

morning-club: When was the last time brunch gave you an actual break? Imagine putting the phone away and finding a seat where nobody needs you to organize a thing.
Mommy and Daddy Break Club brings parents together around a slower morning. An edition might pair gentle movement with coffee, brunch or a mimosa.
There is time to relax, meet someone and take a photo. Each invitation tells you what's planned for that date.
Behind the morning, VNV coordinates catering, décor, multimedia, staffing and logistics. Your host handles the details so you can stay for the conversation.
Our producers work on more than two hundred and fifty small and midsize events each year, in addition to corporate productions. This one has a pace all its own.
Join the free priority list. When an edition opens, you'll see the details and can decide whether to book your places.

Every Retro Glam Sessions edition is built around one era. A seventies disco night has a different sound, lighting design and atmosphere from an eighties neon party.
We carry that idea through the live stage, the DJ set and the photo moments. Guests step into a room designed around the music they came to hear.
Our producers coordinate décor, multimedia, catering, staffing and logistics. We select the vendors and call their cues so the whole night moves as one show.
Each year, we produce more than two hundred and fifty small and midsize events, in addition to our corporate productions. That experience shapes every edition.
